I wrote the solution to `main.wj`. It sieves primes up to 200000 once. It then precomputes the prime count and the largest prime for every `n`, so each query is a table lookup.

I ran it in the interpreter on Example 2 and the output matched. I did not run Example 1 or any other input. `wj check --json` reports no errors or warnings. I did not run `wj build`, so the compiled path is untested.
